pkgmetadata.longdescription: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit provides a development environment for creating high performance GPU-accelerated applications. Starting with 13.1.1, the toolkit includes the cuObject client library (cuobjclient) for GPU-direct object storage via RDMA.

use.flag: Use clang as host compiler instead of gcc
Install libcufile_rdma and libcuobjclient for GPUDirect Storage over RDMA
